Optional\n+Ghostscript creates a potentially lossy email rewrite, published only when it is\n+validated and smaller than the master. Source PDFs and existing outputs are preserved.\n+Keep originals and inspect the results before sharing them.\n+\n+The repository is **WinPDFMerger**; the established launchers remain\n+**WinPDFMerge.ps1** and **WinPDFMerge.bat**. Processing stays local, with no application\n+downloads, uploads, telemetry or self-update. This is a folder-based Windows tool;\n+website work, cloud conversion, OCR, a GUI editor and an installer are outside its scope.\n+\n+## Install\n+\n+1. Use a Windows 11 x64 computer and a normal user account. Windows PowerShell 5.1\n+   is the batch launcher's host. Direct invocation has also been tested on PowerShell\n+   7.6.6 x64. These are scoped test observations, not completed release certification.\n+   Windows 10, ARM, 32-bit hosts and live UNC shares are unvalidated and excluded\n+   from validated v1.0.0 support; see the [compatibility scope](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md).\n+2. Install [PDFtk Server for Windows](https://www.pdflabs.com/tools/pdftk-server/)\n+   from its vendor. PDFtk is required. Install\n+   [Ghostscript](https://www.ghostscript.com/releases/gsdnld.html) only if you want\n+   an email copy; it is optional. Review the separate\n+   [dependency terms and selection rules](docs/DEPENDENCIES.md).\n+3. For the current source, use **Code > Download ZIP** in the\n+   [repository](https://github.com/PikkuJanne/WinPDFMerger), or use your checkout.\n+   Extract the whole project folder to a location such as `C:\\Tools\\WinPDFMerge`.\n+   Keep the relative layout below, including `VERSION` beside the launchers and\n+   `src/WinPDFMerge.Helpers.ps1`; copying just the two launchers is insufficient.\n+   The `docs` folder supplies the linked public instructions. Native dependencies\n+   are installed separately, and Python is not needed to run the application.\n+\n+```text\n+C:\\Tools\\WinPDFMerge\\\n+    WinPDFMerge.ps1\n+    WinPDFMerge.bat\n+    VERSION\n+    README.md\n+    LICENSE\n+    SECURITY.md\n+    src\\\n+        WinPDFMerge.Helpers.ps1\n+    docs\\\n+        USAGE.md\n+        TROUBLESHOOTING.md\n+        DEPENDENCIES.md\n+        COMPATIBILITY.md\n+        PDF_LIMITATIONS.md\n+        EMAIL_PRESETS.md\n+```\n+\n+4. In PowerShell, verify a PATH installation with `pdftk.exe --version` and,\n+   if installed, `gswin64c.exe --version`. A tool outside PATH can still be selected\n+   from the documented standard locations; the run reports its actual path/version.\n+   Version detection does not establish trust. The application installs nothing.\n+5. Choose a source folder and a **separate existing writable output folder**.\n+   By default, output is beside `WinPDFMerge.ps1`, so that script directory must\n+   be writable. Use `-OutputFolder` if it is not. The application does not create\n+   destinations or silently choose another location.\n+\n+The scripts are unsigned. Downloaded scripts or enterprise policy may block them.\n+Verify the source and follow your organization's approved process; do not disable\n+security controls or change machine-wide execution policy. See\n+[security and signing limits](SECURITY.md) and [blocked-script guidance](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md#script-blocked).\n+Release status recorded 2026-10-09 before source acceptance and publication:\n+v1.0.0 is not yet published. Exact premerge candidate ZIPs passed\n+automated Windows operation and unchanged-source checks in both required shells\n+on 2026-10-09. Those local candidates are not a published release download.\n+See [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/PikkuJanne/WinPDFMerger/releases) for current\n+publication status and assets. The remaining gates below describe this dated review.\n+\n+Validation evidence covers scoped automated Windows native, dual-shell and hosted\n+CI tests. At the owner's direction, human standard-user and Explorer validation\n+is excluded from project scope and was not performed. This exclusion is not a\n+manual pass. Exact release ZIP and downloaded-package checks remain later gates;\n+the accepted merged source and its final assets still require their own checks.\n+See the [compatibility scope](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md).\n+\n+## Use\n+\n+Put the intended PDFs directly in one source folder. Subfolders and hidden files\n+are not scanned; `.pdf` and `.PDF` are included. One PDF is valid; zero PDFs fails.\n+Files sort naturally by base filename: `1, 01, 001, 2, 10`. Rename your own working\n+copies if you need a different order, and check the numbered input list in the log.\n+Existing results placed in the source folder are inputs too; there is no filename-prefix exclusion.\n+\n+For the default workflow, drag **exactly one folder** onto `WinPDFMerge.bat` in\n+Explorer. It uses Windows PowerShell 5.1, writes beside the scripts, and pauses to\n+show the result and log path. Double-click without a folder shows usage and fails;\n+there is no folder picker. Human Explorer drag-and-drop validation is excluded\n+and was not performed.\n+\n+For named options, open PowerShell in the extracted script directory:\n+\n+```powershell\n+Set-Location -LiteralPath 'C:\\Tools\\WinPDFMerge'\n+.\\WinPDFMerge.ps1 \"C:\\Work\\Docs\\ToMerge\"\n+.\\WinPDFMerge.ps1 \"C:\\Work\\Docs\\ToMerge\" -OutputFolder \"C:\\Work\\Merged\"\n+.\\WinPDFMerge.ps1 \"C:\\Work\\Docs\\ToMerge\" -EmailPreset ebook\n+.\\WinPDFMerge.ps1 \"C:\\Work\\Docs\\ToMerge\" -SkipEmail\n+```\n+\n+Replace the example paths with your existing folders. `SourceFolder` is the only\n+positional argument. `-EmailPreset` accepts `screen` (default) or `ebook` only.\n+`-SkipEmail` bypasses Ghostscript discovery and execution; an explicitly supplied,\n+valid preset is reported as ignored. The batch launcher accepts one source folder,\n+so use the `.ps1` for options. Built-in help is available without running a merge:\n+\n+```powershell\n+Get-Help .\\WinPDFMerge.ps1 -Examples\n+```\n+\n+`cmd.exe` can expand a paired `%NAME%` token in a quoted source or script path\n+before the batch file starts. From PowerShell, use the `.ps1` directly to retain\n+literal percent characters (replace both paths with your actual locations):\n+\n+```powershell\n+powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File 'C:\\Tools\\WinPDFMerge\\WinPDFMerge.ps1' -SourceFolder 'C:\\Work\\source%NAME%'\n+```\n+\n+This is the launcher's existing process-scoped policy flag; it changes no user or\n+machine setting and does not override Group Policy. Use it only where local policy\n+permits this route. [Microsoft describes the policy scopes and precedence](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powershell/module/microsoft.powershell.core/about/about_execution_policies?view=powershell-5.1).\n+\n+## Results and exit codes\n+\n+The master, optional `_email.pdf` and UTF-8 `.log` share a name such as\n+`WinPDFMerge_ToMerge_20261008_120000_<run>.pdf`, with a random run suffix.\n+Existing files are never overwritten. The master is validated and published\n+before optional email processing; it survives an email failure. A larger or equal\n+email candidate is omitted with a **no size benefit** message.\n+\n+| Code | Result | What to do |\n+| --- | --- | --- |\n+| `0` | Success: validated master; email produced, explicitly skipped, Ghostscript absent, or no smaller candidate | Use the reported master; an email copy exists only if listed as published. |\n+| `1` | Failure: invalid invocation/input/destination, missing or unusable PDFtk, or failure before master publication | Read the console/log; no validated master is advertised. Correct the cause and rerun. |\n+| `2` | Partial success: validated master retained, but email or a later operation failed/interrupted | Keep the reported master and inspect the diagnostic; no failed email candidate is advertised. |\n+\n+The batch file returns the exact code after its pause. For a direct script call,\n+read `$LASTEXITCODE` immediately afterward. Warnings on stderr alone do not decide\n+success. Closing the window, killing the host or a crash cannot guarantee a code\n+or cleanup. See [usage details and recovery](docs/USAGE.md).\n+\n+## Quality, privacy and help\n+\n+The email presets can lose small text, image detail, editable fields and other\n+features; there is no guaranteed attachment size. Inspect the actual copy.\n+See [observed preset tradeoffs](docs/EMAIL_PRESETS.md) and\n+[PDF preservation limits](docs/PDF_LIMITATIONS.md). These files can be confidential.\r\n+\r\n+Logs and outputs are not automatically redacted, encrypted or given a special\r\n+application ACL. No merge was started. {0}\" -f $_.Exception.Message)\r\n+    exit 1\r\n+}\r\n+\r\n+# One owned stage for master and email. Publication state is recorded before\r\n+# logging so later optional/log exceptions retain the validated master outcome.\r\n+$staging = $null\r\n+$masterPublished = $false\r\n+$sizeReport = $null\r\n+$emailState = 'not_started'\r\n+$failureMessage = $null\r\n+$runFailed = $false\r\n+try {\r\n+    $cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()\r\n+    $staging = New-PdfStaging -OutputFolder $OutputFolder -RunIdentity $run.BaseName\r\n+    (\"Private staging: {0}\" -f $staging.DirectoryPath) | Write-RunLog -LiteralPath $logPath -Append\r\n+    Assert-PdfInputInventory -Inventory $inventory\r\n+    Write-PdfRunStage -Stage 'Master processing' -Timer $runTimer -LiteralPath $logPath\r\n+    $merge = Invoke-PdfToolJob -Tool Pdftk -Executable $pdftkPath -InputPaths @($inventory.Inputs.FullName) -OutputPath $outLossless -Staging $staging -ExpectedPageCount $inventory.ExpectedPageCount -CancellationToken $cancellationToken\r\n+    $masterPublished = ($merge.OutputPublished -and $merge.OutputValidated)\r\n+    if ($masterPublished) {\r\n+        $sizeReport = Get-PdfSizeReport -MasterBytes (Get-PdfInputSnapshot -LiteralPath $outLossless).Length\r\n+    }\r\n+    if ($null -ne $merge.NativeResult) {\r\n+        Write-NativeProcessLog -Result $merge.NativeResult -LiteralPath $logPath -Label PDFtk\r\n+    }\r\n+    if ($null -ne $merge.ValidationResult -and $null -ne $merge.ValidationResult.NativeResult) {\r\n+        Write-NativeProcessLog -Result $merge.ValidationResult.NativeResult -LiteralPath $logPath -Label 'Master validation'\r\n+    }\r\n+    if ($merge.CleanupError) { $merge.CleanupError | Write-RunLog -LiteralPath $logPath -Append }\r\n+    if (-not $merge.Succeeded) { throw (\"PDFtk master processing failed. {0}\" -f $merge.OutputError) }\r\n+    (\"Master validation OK: {0} expected pages inspected. Merged master published: {1}\" -f $merge.ValidatedPageCount, $outLossless) | Write-RunLog -LiteralPath $logPath -Append\r\n+\r\n+    $cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()\r\n+    if ($SkipEmail) {\r\n+        # Explicit skip bypasses discovery, version probes and native GS launch.\r\n+        $emailState = 'skipped'\r\n+    } else {\r\n+        Write-PdfRunStage -Stage 'Email 'unavailable'\r\n+        } else {\r\n+            $gsVersion = 'not determined'\r\n+            try { $gsVersion = Get-NativeToolVersion -Path $gsPath -Tool Ghostscript -CancellationToken $pdftkPath -EmailPreset $EmailPreset -CancellationToken $cancellationToken\r\n+            if ($email.Succeeded -and $email.OutputValidated -and $email.OutputPublished -and $email.OutputState -eq 'published') {\r\n+                $emailState = 'published'\r\n+            } elseif ($email.Succeeded -and $email.OutputValidated -and -not $email.OutputPublished -and $email.OutputState -eq 'no_size_benefit') {\r\n+                $emailState = 'no_size_benefit'\r\n+            } else {\r\n+                $emailState = 'failed'\r\n+            }\r\n+            if ($emailState -in @('published','no_size_benefit')) {\r\n+                $sizeReport = Get-PdfSizeReport -MasterBytes $email.MasterBytes -EmailBytes $email.OutputBytes -EmailPublished:($emailState -eq            }\r\n+            if ($null -ne $email.ValidationResult -and $null -ne $email.ValidationResult.NativeResult) {\r\n+                Write-NativeProcessLog -Result $email.ValidationResult.NativeResult -LiteralPath $logPath -Label 'Email validation'\r\n+            }\r\n+            if ($email.CleanupError) { $email.CleanupError | Write-RunLog -LiteralPath $logPath -Append }\r\n+            if ($emailState -eq 'failed') { throw (\"Ghostscript email processing failed. {0}\" -f $email.OutputError) }\r\n+        }\r\n+    }\r\n+    $cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()\r\n+} catch {\r\n+    $failureMessage = $_.Exception.Message\r\n+    $runFailed = $true\r\n+    if ($masterPublished -and $emailState -eq 'not_started') { $emailState = 'failed' }\r\n+    try { $failureMessage | Write-RunLog -LiteralPath $logPath -Append | Out-Null }\r\n+    catch { Write-Host (\"Failure diagnostic could not be logged: {0}\" -f $_.Exception.Message) -ForegroundColor Yellow }\r\n+} finally {\r\n+    if ($null -ne $staging) {\r\n+        try { $cleanup = Remove-PdfStaging -Staging $staging }\r\n+        catch {\r\n+            $runFailed = $true\r\n+            $failureMessage = \"Staging cleanup failed; retained path '$($staging.DirectoryPath)'. $($_.Exception.Message)\"\r\n+            $cleanup = [pscustomobject]@{ CleanupError=$failureMessage }\r\n+        }\r\n+        if ($cleanup.CleanupError) {\r\n+            Write-Host $cleanup.CleanupError -ForegroundColor Yellow\r\n+            try { $cleanup.CleanupError | Write-RunLog -LiteralPath $logPath -Append | Out-Null }\r\n+            catch { Write-Host (\"Staging cleanup diagnostic could not be logged: {0}\" -f $_.Exception.Message) PowerShell aliases/functions and missing files are ignored. Exit `0` includes master-only success,\r\n+`1` means no validated master was advertised, and `2` means partial success with\r\n+a validated master retained. The master survives email failure. Use the exact\r\n+console/log diagnostic, rather than assuming every warning means failure.\r\n+See the [full exit-code table](../README.md#results-and-exit-codes).\r\n+\r\n+## Script blocked\r\n+\r\n+The PowerShell script is unsigned. Downloaded-file checks or organizational\r\n+execution policy may block it before application code runs. Verify the source and\r\n+follow your organization's approved procedure for trusted scripts; consult your\r\n+administrator if policy forbids execution. Do not disable security software,\r\n+relax Group Policy or change user/machine policy to make the tool run.\r\n+\r\n+The BAT retains its existing process-only `Bypass` flag, which does not override\r\n+organizational policy or establish trust. Direct examples use the current host's\r\n+policy. A SHA-256 match checks bytes, not publisher identity, signing or malware.\r\n+See [security and signing](../SECURITY.md#unsigned-scripts-and-integrity).\r\n+\r\n+## Usage or incomplete application folder\r\n+\r\n+Supply exactly one existing source folder. Double-clicking the BAT without a\r\n+folder only displays usage and pauses; dropping multiple folders is refused.\r\n+Use the `.ps1` for `-OutputFolder`, `-SkipEmail` or `-EmailPreset ebook`.\r\n+Missing source input exits `1` without an interactive prompt.\r\n+\r\n+If a launcher/helper or `VERSION` cannot be found, or `VERSION` is invalid,\r\n+extract the complete project again. Keep its unmodified `VERSION` beside the\r\n+launchers and `src/WinPDFMerge.Helpers.ps1` in its `src` directory. See the\r\n+[installation layout](../README.md#install). Do not copy only the PS1/BAT files.\r\n+Unknown options, extra positional paths or an invalid preset fail before output\r\n+creation; check spelling and use `Get-Help .\\WinPDFMerge.ps1 -Examples`.\r\n+\r\n+## Source or output preflight failed\r\n+\r\n+Use existing filesystem directories. Source and output cannot be the same\r\n+directory, even through case or supported aliases. Reparse/junction ancestors are\r\n+refused. Choose direct paths and an existing writable `-OutputFolder` separate\r\n+from the source. Output defaults beside the entry script, so a protected install\r\n+folder needs an explicit destination. The application creates no destination and\r\n+does not choose another folder silently. Normal operation requires no administrator.\r\n+\r\n+If no log exists, read the console. Binding, source/destination checks and log\r\n+reservation can fail before a usable log is available. Shorten paths for native\r\n+limits; see [path bounds and measured Unicode limits](USAGE.md#paths-and-destinations).\r\n+For literal paired `%NAME%` tokens, use the documented direct PowerShell route.\r\n+\r\n+## PDFtk missing or unusable\r\n+\r\n+Install PDFtk Server from its vendor and check the selected installation/PATH.\r\n+The script ignores aliases/functions and tries the documented\r\n+[executable locations](DEPENDENCIES.md#selection-and-diagnostics).\r\n+A five-second version probe must succeed; a found but unusable PDFtk stops the\r\n+run before master creation. Read both native streams in the diagnostic log when\r\n+one was created. No dependency is downloaded or installed automatically.\r\n+\r\n+## Empty, protected or unparseable input\r\n+\r\n+Check the numbered input list. Only visible top-level `.pdf`/`.PDF` files are\r\n+included; hidden files and nested folders are not. One valid PDF is enough.\r\n+Previous outputs manually placed in the source folder are included too.\r\n+\r\n+An empty, corrupt/truncated, unsupported envelope, ambiguous/zero-page or unreadable\r\n+protected PDF stops the whole run. The tool does not skip it, ask for passwords,\r\n+repair it or flatten features. Obtain an authorized readable working copy when\r\n+appropriate, preserve the original and rerun with the intended copies. Do not\r\n+remove document restrictions without authorization. A PDFtk-readable document\r\n+can still have unreported malformations or feature loss.\r\n+\r\n+If a source changes while processing, stop editing/syncing it and rerun with stable\r\n+files. Snapshot checks detect obvious length/modification changes, not every race.\r\n+For sharing, inspect [preservation limits](PDF_LIMITATIONS.md), especially signatures,\r\n+forms, attachments and accessibility tags.\r\n+\r\n+## Email copy missing or partial success\r\n+\r\n+An absent email file can be a successful result: `-SkipEmail`, unavailable optional\r\n+Ghostscript or a valid candidate with no size benefit all return `0`. The log says\r\n+which occurred. Install Ghostscript separately only if needed, or use the master.\r\n+\r\n+If Ghostscript is found but its probe, conversion, validation or publication fails,\r\n+the result is `2` with the master retained. Read the selected tool path/version,\r\n+both streams and final stage state. No failed candidate is advertised as an output.\r\n+A larger/equal candidate is discarded and cannot be recovered as a published email\r\n+file. Try `ebook` for a different quality tradeoff or `-SkipEmail` for the master;\r\n+neither promises a target size. Inspect the output before emailing it.\r\n+\r\n+## Locked files, interrupted runs or output collision\r\n+\r\n+Close programs holding source or owned staging files and confirm the output directory\r\n+is writable. Native launch, permissions, antivirus/file locks, logging and publication\r\n+can each fail; use the named stage and exact paths in the diagnostic. Existing final\r\n+PDFs are never overwritten or deleted. Do not delete an existing result to retry;\r\n+a new run gets a fresh identity. A file created at the final name during a run\r\n+causes publication to fail safely.\r\n+\r\n+Ctrl+C depends on console-host event delivery. Controlled interruption before the\r\n+master returns `1`; afterward it returns `2` and retains published files. Window\r\n+closure, host termination or a crash can leave a partial log/staging and no reliable\r\n+exit code. Check actual published paths before rerunning.\r\n+\r\n+## Orphan staging\r\n+\r\n+A crash or cleanup failure can leave an exact private\r\n+`.WinPDFMerge_<32 hex characters>.tmp` folder in the output directory. When cleanup\r\n+fails, the console/log reports that path. After **all merge runs have stopped**,\r\n+inspect that exact folder and its `owner.json` marker and known temporary paths.\r\n+Only remove it manually when you have established it is an abandoned run you own.\r\n+A missing marker, unexpected content or uncertain process state requires manual\r\n+investigation. Do not sweep by filename prefix or remove another/active run's files.\r\n+Keep validated final PDFs and logs outside staging.\r\n+\r\n+## Report a problem\r\n+\r\n+Use the repository's [issue tracker](https://github.com/PikkuJanne/WinPDFMerger/issues)\r\n+for ordinary bugs. Include script revision, Windows/shell/tool versions, exit code,\r\n+stage and a minimal **synthetic** reproduction. Make a copy of the log and replace\r\n+private paths, names and metadata consistently before sharing. Do not attach private\r\n+PDFs, credentials or unsanitized logs. Keep\r\n+`WinPDFMerge.ps1`, `WinPDFMerge.bat`, adjacent `VERSION` and\r\n+`src/WinPDFMerge.Helpers.ps1` in their relative layout. The repository name is\r\n+WinPDFMerger; launcher filenames retain WinPDFMerge. Processing requires PDFtk\r\n+and optionally Ghostscript, with no Python runtime dependency.\r\n+\r\n+## Parameters and shells\r\n+\r\n+| Parameter | Meaning |\r\n+| --- | --- |\r\n+| `SourceFolder` | Exactly one existing filesystem directory; optional positional binding, but missing input prints usage and exits `1`. |\r\n+| `-OutputFolder` | An existing writable directory separate from the source. Default: directory of the entry script. No automatic creation or fallback. |\r\n+| `-SkipEmail` | Publish only the validated master; never discover or launch Ghostscript. |\r\n+| `-EmailPreset screen\\|ebook` | Fixed Ghostscript profile, default `screen`. No arbitrary native argument strings. |\r\n+\r\n+Invalid presets, extra positional directories and unknown options fail before\r\n+output creation. A valid explicit preset with `-SkipEmail` is ignored and explained.\r\n+PowerShell 7.6.6 x64 was separately tested; the batch launcher always uses Windows\r\n+PowerShell 5.1 with `-NoProfile`. To use the PS7 host explicitly, open `pwsh.exe`\r\n+and run this inside that PowerShell session, replacing the paths:\r\n+\r\n+```powershell\r\n+& 'C:\\Tools\\WinPDFMerge\\WinPDFMerge.ps1' -SourceFolder 'C:\\Work\\Docs\\ToMerge' -OutputFolder 'C:\\Work\\Merged' -SkipEmail\r\n+$LASTEXITCODE\r\n+```\r\n+\r\n+This example runs in the current host. It does not change execution policy or\r\n+override script-blocking rules. `Get-Help .\\WinPDFMerge.ps1 -Full` reads help\r\n+without starting application orchestration. See [blocked scripts](TROUBLESHOOTING.md#script-blocked).\r\n+\r\n+## Inputs and merge order\r\n+\r\n+Only visible top-level files with a case-insensitive `.pdf` extension are inputs.\r\n+Hidden files and subfolders are excluded. One PDF is accepted; an empty folder is\r\n+an error. A file named `WinPDFMerge_*.pdf` is still a legitimate input: keep previous\r\n+results out of the source folder if you do not want them included.\r\n+\r\n+ASCII digit runs sort by integer magnitude without fixed-width integer limits.\r\n+For equal numeric values, shorter digit runs sort first (`1, 01, 001`), then\r\n+subsequent segments decide the order. Text comparison is ordinal and case-insensitive;\r\n+the original base name and canonical full path break remaining ties ordinally.\r\n+Non-ASCII digits are text. The log records the final numbered input list.\r\n+\r\n+The input set is frozen before processing. Every input is inspected by PDFtk's\r\n+read-only `dump_data_utf8` and must have a positive unambiguous page count. Empty,\r\n+unparseable, zero-page or unsupported password-protected files stop the whole run;\r\n+none is silently omitted. There is no password, repair or flatten option.\r\n+PDFtk-readable encryption with an empty password is not automatically refused.\r\n+For protected documents, obtain an authorized readable working copy while keeping\r\n+the original; do not remove restrictions without authorization.\r\n+\r\n+The preliminary envelope check requires a PDF header at the start, a final\r\n+`startxref`/`%%EOF` within the last 8192 bytes, and a positive in-file cross-reference\r\n+offset targeting `xref` or a plausible indirect-object header within 1024 bytes.\r\n+Non-whitespace after final EOF and layouts beyond those bounds are refused.\r\n+This is bounded structural screening, not universal PDF validation or a malware scan.\r\n+\r\n+Keep sources stable while merging. Length and UTC modification-time checks around\r\n+inspection and before assembly detect obvious changes but do not provide a\r\n+filesystem snapshot. Newly added files are not added to the frozen set. The tool\r\n+does not edit, rename, replace or delete source PDFs.\r\n+\r\n+## Paths and destinations\r\n+\r\n+Source and output must identify different directories, including case variants\r\n+and supported short-name aliases. Junctions, symbolic links and other reparse\r\n+directories at either path or an ancestor are refused; use direct directory paths.\r\n+The output directory must already exist and be writable. A short create-new probe\r\n+is removed when its owned handle closes; existing files are never used as probes.\r\n+\r\n+Native file operands must be shorter than 260 UTF-16 characters, including their\r\n+directories. The destination must also leave room for private staging. A complete\r\n+serialized native command is limited to 30,000 UTF-16 characters including the\r\n+executable, quotes, separator and terminator. Oversized jobs fail before native\r\n+launch; use fewer inputs or shorter paths. There is no chunked or long-path workaround.\r\n+\r\n+In the tested Windows PDFtk Server 2.02 backend, spaces, brackets, exclamation\r\n+marks, ampersands, parentheses, apostrophes and Latin `ä` worked in operands.\r\n+CJK source/input and output paths failed in that backend, although a CJK tool\r\n+installation directory worked. These observations do not promise all Unicode\r\n+names work. Unsupported inputs fail without renaming sources. Live UNC shares,\r\n+Windows 10, ARM and 32-bit hosts are unvalidated and excluded from validated\r\n+v1.0.0 support; see the [compatibility scope and rationale](COMPATIBILITY.md).\r\n+\r\n+For paired `%NAME%` characters in source or installation paths, use the\r\n+[direct PowerShell route](../README.md#use): `cmd.exe` may expand them before\r\n+the batch launcher receives the path. The launcher cannot recover the original.\r\n+\r\n+## Publication and email quality\r\n+\r\n+Outputs use `WinPDFMerge_<Folder>_<yyyyMMdd_HHmmss>_<run>` with a random\r\n+16-hex-character suffix shared by the master, `_email.pdf` and `.log`.\r\n+Folder labels are bounded to 64 UTF-16 characters and shortened further for the\r\n+destination. Root/empty labels become `root`, and trailing dots/spaces are removed\r\n+from the derived output label. Inputs are never renamed.\r\n+\r\n+Native work happens in one private `.WinPDFMerge_<32 hex characters>.tmp`\r\n+directory under the output directory. Final files are moved into place only after\r\n+validation, with no-overwrite semantics. The validated master is published before\r\n+email processing and survives later failure. A separately validated email candidate\r\n+is published only if smaller than the master; otherwise it is discarded from this\r\n+run's staging and reported as no size benefit. Existing outputs remain untouched.\r\n+\r\n+`screen` maps to `-dPDFSETTINGS=/screen`; `ebook` maps to `/ebook`. Ghostscript's\r\n+pdfwrite device rewrites the document with fixed flags including `-dSAFER` and\r\n+`-dPDFSTOPONERROR`. No public parameter relaxes those restrictions. The script\r\n+clears `GS_OPTIONS` only in selected children; the caller's environment remains intact.\r\n+These flags do not certify hostile-file isolation or PDF preservation.\r\n+\r\n+Reports show exact byte counts, binary units (`KiB` = 1024 bytes, `MiB` = 1048576)\r\n+and percentage reduction relative to the master. `B` uses whole bytes; `KiB` and\r\n+larger units use two decimals, and percentages one; exact bytes are authoritative.\r\n+Larger/equal candidates can\r\n+show zero/negative reduction but are never listed as published email outputs.\r\n+Skipped, absent or failed email processing reports only the retained master size.\r\n+There is no target attachment-size guarantee. See [preset tradeoffs](EMAIL_PRESETS.md)\r\n+and [feature preservation limits](PDF_LIMITATIONS.md).\r\n+\r\n+## Diagnostics, interruption and cleanup\r\n+\r\n+The console/log records stage names and measured elapsed time, not an estimated\r\n+percentage. The UTF-8 log is reserved after safe source/destination validation and\r\n+before discovery/dependency probes. It contains versions, numbered inputs, page\r\n+counts, native executable/arguments, both streams, timing/failure flags, sizes and\r\n+published paths. Unknown counts or unused tools are labelled explicitly.\r\n+Missing input, binding errors and unsafe/unwritable destinations can fail before\r\n+a log exists. Use the console then. [Logs can be confidential](../SECURITY.md#privacy-and-logs).\r\n+\r\n+Each native job has a 15-minute execution limit; version probes have five seconds.\r\n+Standard input is closed. Controlled Ctrl+C requests cancellation when the console\r\n+host delivers the event. Controlled timeout/cancellation returns `1` before master\r\n+publication or `2` afterward, retaining validated published PDFs. The batch pause\r\n+propagates the exact result when the host survives. Abrupt host/window/machine\r\n+termination cannot guarantee cleanup, a final log or an exit code.\r\n+\r\n+The ownership marker `owner.json` records run identity, creation time, process ID\r\n+and known temporary files. Cleanup touches only the current run's owned known\r\n+paths, never sweeps old staging and preserves published PDFs. If process termination,\r\n+ownership or cleanup is uncertain, staging can remain for manual inspection.\r\n+A cleanup-only warning can accompany success after valid outputs are published.\r\n+See [safe orphan cleanup](TROUBLESHOOTING.md#orphan-staging); do not delete an active\r\n+run's folder or another run's files. The [exit-code table](../README.md#results-and-exit-codes)\r\n+is the public result Optional\n+Ghostscript creates a potentially lossy email rewrite, published only when it is\n+validated and smaller than the master. Source PDFs and existing outputs are preserved.\n+Keep originals and inspect the results before sharing them.\n+\n+The repository is **WinPDFMerger**; the established launchers remain\n+**WinPDFMerge.ps1** and **WinPDFMerge.bat**. Processing stays local, with no application\n+downloads, uploads, telemetry or self-update. This is a folder-based Windows tool;\n+website work, cloud conversion, OCR, a GUI editor and an installer are outside its scope.\n+\n+## Install\n+\n+1. Use a Windows 11 x64 computer and a normal user account. Windows PowerShell 5.1\n+   is the batch launcher's host. Direct invocation has also been tested on PowerShell\n+   7.6.6 x64. These are scoped test observations, not completed release certification.\n+   Windows 10, ARM, 32-bit hosts and live UNC shares are unvalidated and excluded\n+   from validated v1.0.0 support; see the [compatibility scope](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md).\n+2. Install [PDFtk Server for Windows](https://www.pdflabs.com/tools/pdftk-server/)\n+   from its vendor. PDFtk is required. Install\n+   [Ghostscript](https://www.ghostscript.com/releases/gsdnld.html) only if you want\n+   an email copy; it is optional. Review the separate\n+   [dependency terms and selection rules](docs/DEPENDENCIES.md).\n+3. For the current source, use **Code > Download ZIP** in the\n+   [repository](https://github.com/PikkuJanne/WinPDFMerger), or use your checkout.\n+   Extract the whole project folder to a location such as `C:\\Tools\\WinPDFMerge`.\n+   Keep the relative layout below, including `VERSION` beside the launchers and\n+   `src/WinPDFMerge.Helpers.ps1`; copying just the two launchers is insufficient.\n+   The `docs` folder supplies the linked public instructions. Native dependencies\n+   are installed separately, and Python is not needed to run the application.\n+\n+```text\n+C:\\Tools\\WinPDFMerge\\\n+    WinPDFMerge.ps1\n+    WinPDFMerge.bat\n+    VERSION\n+    README.md\n+    LICENSE\n+    SECURITY.md\n+    src\\\n+        WinPDFMerge.Helpers.ps1\n+    docs\\\n+        USAGE.md\n+        TROUBLESHOOTING.md\n+        DEPENDENCIES.md\n+        COMPATIBILITY.md\n+        PDF_LIMITATIONS.md\n+        EMAIL_PRESETS.md\n+```\n+\n+4. In PowerShell, verify a PATH installation with `pdftk.exe --version` and,\n+   if installed, `gswin64c.exe --version`. A tool outside PATH can still be selected\n+   from the documented standard locations; the run reports its actual path/version.\n+   Version detection does not establish trust. The application installs nothing.\n+5. Choose a source folder and a **separate existing writable output folder**.\n+   By default, output is beside `WinPDFMerge.ps1`, so that script directory must\n+   be writable. Use `-OutputFolder` if it is not. The application does not create\n+   destinations or silently choose another location.\n+\n+The scripts are unsigned. Accepted merged source, final assets and independently downloaded\r\n+published ZIP operation remain later gates. The application version comes from\r\n+[VERSION](../VERSION); native tool and shell versions below are separate.\r\n+\r\n+## Familiar workflow and defaults\r\n+\r\n+Keep the complete project layout and the established `WinPDFMerge.ps1` and\r\n+`WinPDFMerge.bat` entry points. Drag exactly one source folder onto the batch\r\n+launcher, which uses Windows PowerShell 5.1 and pauses to show the result, or\r\n+invoke the PowerShell script directly for named options. Human Explorer\r\n+drag-and-drop validation is excluded and was not performed.\r\n+\r\n+Only visible top-level `.pdf` files are scanned, with case-insensitive extension\r\n+matching and no recursion. PDFtk creates the merged master without intentional\r\n+page rasterization or image downsampling. Optional Ghostscript creates a\r\n+potentially lossy email rewrite. Processing stays local with no application\r\n+network calls, uploads, telemetry, dependency installation or self-update.\r\n+\r\n+Output still defaults to the entry script's directory, and the email preset\r\n+still defaults to `/screen`. Use `-OutputFolder` for a separate existing writable\r\n+directory, `-SkipEmail` to bypass Ghostscript, or `-EmailPreset ebook` for the\r\n+fixed alternative preset. No destination is silently created or substituted.\r\n+See the [README](../README.md) and [usage details](USAGE.md).\r\n+\r\n+## First-release improvements\r\n+\r\n+- One PDF is valid; zero PDFs fails. The discovered set is frozen, every input\r\n+  is inspected, and unusable inputs stop the whole run without silent omission.\r\n+- Natural filename order is deterministic across cultures and supports long\r\n+  ASCII numeric segments. For equal values, shorter digit runs come first:\r\n+  `1, 01, 001, 2, 10`. The log records the numbered merge order.\r\n+- Source/output overlap, unsupported reparse paths, unwritable destinations and\r\n+  practical native path/command limits are checked before unsafe work.\r\n+- A random run suffix separates concurrent jobs. Owned staging keeps incomplete\r\n+  outputs away from final paths. Native exit state, nonempty PDF structure and\r\n+  expected page totals are checked before no-overwrite publication.\r\n+- A validated master is published first and survives email failure. Only a\r\n+  valid email candidate strictly smaller than the master is published; equal\r\n+  or larger candidates report **no size benefit**.\r\n+- Native executables are selected as files and invoked directly with controlled\r\n+  arguments, captured stdout/stderr and bounded execution. Ghostscript retains\r\n+  `-dSAFER` and `-dPDFSTOPONERROR`; selected children alone have `GS_OPTIONS`\r\n+  removed. These controls are not a hostile-PDF sandbox.\r\n+- Dependency discovery reports actual paths/versions. Missing optional\r\n+  Ghostscript permits a master-only result; found but unusable Ghostscript\r\n+  yields partial success after the master is retained.\r\n+- Exit codes and the batch presentation distinguish success (`0`), failure\r\n+  (`1`) and partial success (`2`). Logs explain stage, elapsed time, page totals,\r\n+  published paths, exact bytes and size reduction. Cleanup touches owned staging\r\n+  only; abrupt termination can leave staging for documented manual inspection.\r\n+- The small parameter set, built-in help, troubleshooting, preservation and\r\n+  security guidance are backed by regression/fault tests, actual native Windows\r\n+  tests in both required shells and restrained Windows CI.\r\n+- The startup/usage banner and run log read the application version from\r\n+  `VERSION`; built-in help identifies the same source. The measured synthetic\r\n+corpus retained page order but showed field changes, missing document-level\r\n+attachments and accessibility structure, and preset-dependent appearance or\r\n+rotation changes. Those observations do not establish general PDF fidelity.\r\n+Neither output guarantees PDF/A, signature validity, accessibility, universal\r\n+feature retention, archival certification or malware removal. No target email\r\n+attachment size is promised. See [PDF preservation limits](PDF_LIMITATIONS.md)\r\n+and [measured preset tradeoffs](EMAIL_PRESETS.md).\r\n+\r\n+Native operands are bounded below 260 UTF-16 characters and serialized commands\r\n+at 30,000 UTF-16 characters. The tested PDFtk backend refused CJK source/input\r\n+and output paths; other Unicode names are not universally validated. `cmd.exe`\r\n+can expand paired `%NAME%` tokens before the batch launcher starts; use the\r\n+documented direct PowerShell route for literal percent characters. Downloaded-file checks, execution policy,\r\n+SmartScreen or enterprise controls may block them; follow your organization's\r\n+approved process and keep security controls enabled. Exit `0` includes master-only success,\r\n+`1` means no validated master was advertised, and `2` means partial success with\r\n+a validated master retained. The master survives email failure. Use the exact\r\n+console/log diagnostic, rather than assuming every warning means failure.\r\n+See the [full exit-code table](../README.md#results-and-exit-codes).\r\n+\r\n+## Script blocked\r\n+\r\n+The PowerShell script is unsigned. Downloaded-file checks or organizational\r\n+execution policy may block it before application code runs. Verify the source and\r\n+follow your organization's approved procedure for trusted scripts; consult your\r\n+administrator if policy forbids execution. Do not disable security software,\r\n+relax Group Policy or change user/machine policy to make the tool run.\r\n+\r\n+The BAT retains its existing process-only `Bypass` flag, which does not override\r\n+organizational policy or establish trust. Direct examples use the current host's\r\n+policy. A SHA-256 match checks bytes, not publisher identity, signing or malware.\r\n+See [security and signing](../SECURITY.md#unsigned-scripts-and-integrity).\r\n+\r\n+## Usage or incomplete application folder\r\n+\r\n+Supply exactly one existing source folder. Double-clicking the BAT without a\r\n+folder only displays usage and pauses; dropping multiple folders is refused.\r\n+Use the `.ps1` for `-OutputFolder`, `-SkipEmail` or `-EmailPreset ebook`.\r\n+Missing source input exits `1` without an interactive prompt.\r\n+\r\n+If a launcher/helper or `VERSION` cannot be found, or `VERSION` is invalid,\r\n+extract the complete project again. Keep its unmodified `VERSION` beside the\r\n+launchers and `src/WinPDFMerge.Helpers.ps1` in its `src` directory. See the\r\n+[installation layout](../README.md#install). Do not copy only the PS1/BAT files.\r\n+Unknown options, extra positional paths or an invalid preset fail before output\r\n+creation; check spelling and use `Get-Help .\\WinPDFMerge.ps1 -Examples`.\r\n+\r\n+## Source or output preflight failed\r\n+\r\n+Use existing filesystem directories. Source and output cannot be the same\r\n+directory, even through case or supported aliases. Reparse/junction ancestors are\r\n+refused. Choose direct paths and an existing writable `-OutputFolder` separate\r\n+from the source. Output defaults beside the entry script, so a protected install\r\n+folder needs an explicit destination. The application creates no destination and\r\n+does not choose another folder silently. Normal operation requires no administrator.\r\n+\r\n+If no log exists, read the console. Binding, source/destination checks and log\r\n+reservation can fail before a usable log is available. Shorten paths for native\r\n+limits; see [path bounds and measured Unicode limits](USAGE.md#paths-and-destinations).\r\n+For literal paired `%NAME%` tokens, use the documented direct PowerShell route.\r\n+\r\n+## PDFtk missing or unusable\r\n+\r\n+Install PDFtk Server from its vendor and check the selected installation/PATH.\r\n+The script ignores aliases/functions and tries the documented\r\n+[executable locations](DEPENDENCIES.md#selection-and-diagnostics).\r\n+A five-second version probe must succeed; a found but unusable PDFtk stops the\r\n+run before master creation. Read both native streams in the diagnostic log when\r\n+one was created. No dependency is downloaded or installed automatically.\r\n+\r\n+## Empty, protected or unparseable input\r\n+\r\n+Check the numbered input list. Only visible top-level `.pdf`/`.PDF` files are\r\n+included; hidden files and nested folders are not. One valid PDF is enough.\r\n+Previous outputs manually placed in the source folder are included too.\r\n+\r\n+An empty, corrupt/truncated, unsupported envelope, ambiguous/zero-page or unreadable\r\n+protected PDF stops the whole run. The tool does not skip it, ask for passwords,\r\n+repair it or flatten features. Obtain an authorized readable working copy when\r\n+appropriate, preserve the original and rerun with the intended copies. Do not\r\n+remove document restrictions without authorization. A PDFtk-readable document\r\n+can still have unreported malformations or feature loss.\r\n+\r\n+If a source changes while processing, stop editing/syncing it and rerun with stable\r\n+files. Snapshot checks detect obvious length/modification changes, not every race.\r\n+For sharing, inspect [preservation limits](PDF_LIMITATIONS.md), especially signatures,\r\n+forms, attachments and accessibility tags.\r\n+\r\n+## Email copy missing or partial success\r\n+\r\n+An absent email file can be a successful result: `-SkipEmail`, unavailable optional\r\n+Ghostscript or a valid candidate with no size benefit all return `0`. The log says\r\n+which occurred. Install Ghostscript separately only if needed, or use the master.\r\n+\r\n+If Ghostscript is found but its probe, conversion, validation or publication fails,\r\n+the result is `2` with the master retained. Read the selected tool path/version,\r\n+both streams and final stage state. No failed candidate is advertised as an output.\r\n+A larger/equal candidate is discarded and cannot be recovered as a published email\r\n+file. Try `ebook` for a different quality tradeoff or `-SkipEmail` for the master;\r\n+neither promises a target size. Inspect the output before emailing it.\r\n+\r\n+## Locked files, interrupted runs or output collision\r\n+\r\n+Close programs holding source or owned staging files and confirm the output directory\r\n+is writable. Native launch, permissions, antivirus/file locks, logging and publication\r\n+can each fail; use the named stage and exact paths in the diagnostic. Existing final\r\n+PDFs are never overwritten or deleted. Do not delete an existing result to retry;\r\n+a new run gets a fresh identity. A file created at the final name during a run\r\n+causes publication to fail safely.\r\n+\r\n+Ctrl+C depends on console-host event delivery. Controlled interruption before the\r\n+master returns `1`; afterward it returns `2` and retains published files. Window\r\n+closure, host termination or a crash can leave a partial log/staging and no reliable\r\n+exit code. Check actual published paths before rerunning.\r\n+\r\n+## Orphan staging\r\n+\r\n+A crash or cleanup failure can leave an exact private\r\n+`.WinPDFMerge_<32 hex characters>.tmp` folder in the output directory. When cleanup\r\n+fails, the console/log reports that path. After **all merge runs have stopped**,\r\n+inspect that exact folder and its `owner.json` marker and known temporary paths.\r\n+Only remove it manually when you have established it is an abandoned run you own.\r\n+A missing marker, unexpected content or uncertain process state requires manual\r\n+investigation. Do not sweep by filename prefix or remove another/active run's files.\r\n+Keep validated final PDFs and logs outside staging.\r\n+\r\n+## Report a problem\r\n+\r\n+Use the repository's [issue tracker](https://github.com/PikkuJanne/WinPDFMerger/issues)\r\n+for ordinary bugs. Include script revision, Windows/shell/tool versions, exit code,\r\n+stage and a minimal **synthetic** reproduction. Make a copy of the log and replace\r\n+private paths, names and metadata consistently before sharing. Do not attach private\r\n+PDFs, credentials or unsanitized logs. Keep\r\n+`WinPDFMerge.ps1`, `WinPDFMerge.bat`, adjacent `VERSION` and\r\n+`src/WinPDFMerge.Helpers.ps1` in their relative layout. The repository name is\r\n+WinPDFMerger; launcher filenames retain WinPDFMerge. Processing requires PDFtk\r\n+and optionally Ghostscript, with no Python runtime dependency.\r\n+\r\n+## Parameters and shells\r\n+\r\n+| Parameter | Meaning |\r\n+| --- | --- |\r\n+| `SourceFolder` | Exactly one existing filesystem directory; optional positional binding, but missing input prints usage and exits `1`. |\r\n+| `-OutputFolder` | An existing writable directory separate from the source. Default: directory of the entry script. No automatic creation or fallback. |\r\n+| `-SkipEmail` | Publish only the validated master; never discover or launch Ghostscript. |\r\n+| `-EmailPreset screen\\|ebook` | Fixed Ghostscript profile, default `screen`. No arbitrary native argument strings. |\r\n+\r\n+Invalid presets, extra positional directories and unknown options fail before\r\n+output creation. A valid explicit preset with `-SkipEmail` is ignored and explained.\r\n+PowerShell 7.6.6 x64 was separately tested; the batch launcher always uses Windows\r\n+PowerShell 5.1 with `-NoProfile`. To use the PS7 host explicitly, open `pwsh.exe`\r\n+and run this inside that PowerShell session, replacing the paths:\r\n+\r\n+```powershell\r\n+& 'C:\\Tools\\WinPDFMerge\\WinPDFMerge.ps1' -SourceFolder 'C:\\Work\\Docs\\ToMerge' -OutputFolder 'C:\\Work\\Merged' -SkipEmail\r\n+$LASTEXITCODE\r\n+```\r\n+\r\n+This example runs in the current host. It does not change execution policy or\r\n+override script-blocking rules. `Get-Help .\\WinPDFMerge.ps1 -Full` reads help\r\n+without starting application orchestration. See [blocked scripts](TROUBLESHOOTING.md#script-blocked).\r\n+\r\n+## Inputs and merge order\r\n+\r\n+Only visible top-level files with a case-insensitive `.pdf` extension are inputs.\r\n+Hidden files and subfolders are excluded. One PDF is accepted; an empty folder is\r\n+an error. A file named `WinPDFMerge_*.pdf` is still a legitimate input: keep previous\r\n+results out of the source folder if you do not want them included.\r\n+\r\n+ASCII digit runs sort by integer magnitude without fixed-width integer limits.\r\n+For equal numeric values, shorter digit runs sort first (`1, 01, 001`), then\r\n+subsequent segments decide the order. Text comparison is ordinal and case-insensitive;\r\n+the original base name and canonical full path break remaining ties ordinally.\r\n+Non-ASCII digits are text. The log records the final numbered input list.\r\n+\r\n+The input set is frozen before processing. Every input is inspected by PDFtk's\r\n+read-only `dump_data_utf8` and must have a positive unambiguous page count. Empty,\r\n+unparseable, zero-page or unsupported password-protected files stop the whole run;\r\n+none is silently omitted. There is no password, repair or flatten option.\r\n+PDFtk-readable encryption with an empty password is not automatically refused.\r\n+For protected documents, obtain an authorized readable working copy while keeping\r\n+the original; do not remove restrictions without authorization.\r\n+\r\n+The preliminary envelope check requires a PDF header at the start, a final\r\n+`startxref`/`%%EOF` within the last 8192 bytes, and a positive in-file cross-reference\r\n+offset targeting `xref` or a plausible indirect-object header within 1024 bytes.\r\n+Non-whitespace after final EOF and layouts beyond those bounds are refused.\r\n+This is bounded structural screening, not universal PDF validation or a malware scan.\r\n+\r\n+Keep sources stable while merging. Length and UTC modification-time checks around\r\n+inspection and before assembly detect obvious changes but do not provide a\r\n+filesystem snapshot. Newly added files are not added to the frozen set. The tool\r\n+does not edit, rename, replace or delete source PDFs.\r\n+\r\n+## Paths and destinations\r\n+\r\n+Source and output must identify different directories, including case variants\r\n+and supported short-name aliases. Junctions, symbolic links and other reparse\r\n+directories at either path or an ancestor are refused; use direct directory paths.\r\n+The output directory must already exist and be writable. A short create-new probe\r\n+is removed when its owned handle closes; existing files are never used as probes.\r\n+\r\n+Native file operands must be shorter than 260 UTF-16 characters, including their\r\n+directories. The destination must also leave room for private staging. A complete\r\n+serialized native command is limited to 30,000 UTF-16 characters including the\r\n+executable, quotes, separator and terminator. Oversized jobs fail before native\r\n+launch; use fewer inputs or shorter paths. There is no chunked or long-path workaround.\r\n+\r\n+In the tested Windows PDFtk Server 2.02 backend, spaces, brackets, exclamation\r\n+marks, ampersands, parentheses, apostrophes and Latin `ä` worked in operands.\r\n+CJK source/input and output paths failed in that backend, although a CJK tool\r\n+installation directory worked. These observations do not promise all Unicode\r\n+names work. Unsupported inputs fail without renaming sources. Live UNC shares,\r\n+Windows 10, ARM and 32-bit hosts are unvalidated and excluded from validated\r\n+v1.0.0 support; see the [compatibility scope and rationale](COMPATIBILITY.md).\r\n+\r\n+For paired `%NAME%` characters in source or installation paths, use the\r\n+[direct PowerShell route](../README.md#use): `cmd.exe` may expand them before\r\n+the batch launcher receives the path. The launcher cannot recover the original.\r\n+\r\n+## Publication and email quality\r\n+\r\n+Outputs use `WinPDFMerge_<Folder>_<yyyyMMdd_HHmmss>_<run>` with a random\r\n+16-hex-character suffix shared by the master, `_email.pdf` and `.log`.\r\n+Folder labels are bounded to 64 UTF-16 characters and shortened further for the\r\n+destination. Root/empty labels become `root`, and trailing dots/spaces are removed\r\n+from the derived output label. Inputs are never renamed.\r\n+\r\n+Native work happens in one private `.WinPDFMerge_<32 hex characters>.tmp`\r\n+directory under the output directory. Final files are moved into place only after\r\n+validation, with no-overwrite semantics. The validated master is published before\r\n+email processing and survives later failure. A separately validated email candidate\r\n+is published only if smaller than the master; otherwise it is discarded from this\r\n+run's staging and reported as no size benefit. Existing outputs remain untouched.\r\n+\r\n+`screen` maps to `-dPDFSETTINGS=/screen`; `ebook` maps to `/ebook`. Ghostscript's\r\n+pdfwrite device rewrites the document with fixed flags including `-dSAFER` and\r\n+`-dPDFSTOPONERROR`. No public parameter relaxes those restrictions. The script\r\n+clears `GS_OPTIONS` only in selected children; the caller's environment remains intact.\r\n+These flags do not certify hostile-file isolation or PDF preservation.\r\n+\r\n+Reports show exact byte counts, binary units (`KiB` = 1024 bytes, `MiB` = 1048576)\r\n+and percentage reduction relative to the master. `B` uses whole bytes; `KiB` and\r\n+larger units use two decimals, and percentages one; exact bytes are authoritative.\r\n+Larger/equal candidates can\r\n+show zero/negative reduction but are never listed as published email outputs.\r\n+Skipped, absent or failed email processing reports only the retained master size.\r\n+There is no target attachment-size guarantee. See [preset tradeoffs](EMAIL_PRESETS.md)\r\n+and [feature preservation limits](PDF_LIMITATIONS.md).\r\n+\r\n+## Diagnostics, interruption and cleanup\r\n+\r\n+The console/log records stage names and measured elapsed time, not an estimated\r\n+percentage. The UTF-8 log is reserved after safe source/destination validation and\r\n+before discovery/dependency probes. It contains versions, numbered inputs, page\r\n+counts, native executable/arguments, both streams, timing/failure flags, sizes and\r\n+published paths. Unknown counts or unused tools are labelled explicitly.\r\n+Missing input, binding errors and unsafe/unwritable destinations can fail before\r\n+a log exists. Use the console then. [Logs can be confidential](../SECURITY.md#privacy-and-logs).\r\n+\r\n+Each native job has a 15-minute execution limit; version probes have five seconds.\r\n+Standard input is closed. Controlled Ctrl+C requests cancellation when the console\r\n+host delivers the event. Controlled timeout/cancellation returns `1` before master\r\n+publication or `2` afterward, retaining validated published PDFs. The batch pause\r\n+propagates the exact result when the host survives. Abrupt host/window/machine\r\n+termination cannot guarantee cleanup, a final log or an exit code.\r\n+\r\n+The ownership marker `owner.json` records run identity, creation time, process ID\r\n+and known temporary files. Cleanup touches only the current run's owned known\r\n+paths, never sweeps old staging and preserves published PDFs. If process termination,\r\n+ownership or cleanup is uncertain, staging can remain for manual inspection.\r\n+A cleanup-only warning can accompany success after valid outputs are published.\r\n+See [safe orphan cleanup](TROUBLESHOOTING.md#orphan-staging); do not delete an active\r\n+run's folder or another run's files.
